system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write an Ansible playbook deploying a Java application as a systemd service: installs OpenJDK 21, creates a service user, copies the application JAR, writes the systemd unit file, and starts the service. Idempotent across re-runs.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook deploying a Java application as a systemd service: installs OpenJDK 21, creates a service user, copies the application JAR, writes the systemd unit file, and starts the service. Idempotent across re-runs.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Deploy Java application as systemd service
  become: yes
  tasks:
  - name: Install OpenJDK 21
    apt:
      name: openjdk-21-jdk
      state: present

  - name: Create service user
    user:
      name: java-app
      system: yes
      state: present

  - name: Copy application JAR
    copy:
      content: "{{ lookup('file', 'path/to/your/application.jar') }}"
      dest: /opt/java-app/application.jar
      mode: '0644'
      owner: java-app
      group: java-app
    notify: restart java service

  - name: Write systemd unit file
    template:
      src: templates/java-app.service.j2
      dest: /etc/systemd/system/java-app.service
      mode: '0644'
    notify: reload systemd
    notify: restart java service

  - name: Enable and start java service
    systemd:
      name: java-app
      state: started
      enabled: yes
      daemon_reload: yes

  handlers:
  - name: restart java service
    systemd:
      name: java-app
      state: restarted

  - name: reload systemd
    systemd:
      daemon_reload: yes
